articles.headline: FBI Links North Korea to $6 Billion Binance Hack
articles.brief: The FBI has officially linked North Korea to the massive theft of $6 billion from cryptocurrency exchange Binance. Binance reported that it has successfully covered nearly all of the stolen funds from the security breach.

articles.headline: OPEC+ Agrees to Keep Oil Output Targets Steady
articles.brief: OPEC+ sources indicate an agreement in principle to keep oil output targets steady for December, maintaining current production levels amidst shifting global economic conditions and fluctuating energy demands.

articles.headline: Meta Builds Humanoid Robot with Chinese Startup
articles.brief: Meta is reportedly collaborating with Chinese startup Fourier to build an advanced humanoid robot, according to reports from The Information, signaling major tech industry investments in robotics.

articles.headline: Canada and EU Forge 'Alliance for the Future'
articles.brief: Canada and the European Union have launched the 'Alliance for the Future' partnership to deepen cooperation in defence, critical minerals, and technology, aiming to reduce dependence on Washington amidst shifting geopolitical tensions.

articles.headline: INDIA Bloc Stages Mega Protest Rally in Delhi
articles.brief: Thousands of supporters and opposition leaders gathered at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan for the INDIA bloc's 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' rally, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged voter list irregularities.

articles.headline: Ghana Announces Russia to Back 2,000 MW Nuclear Plant
articles.brief: Ghana has announced that Russia will support the development of a 2,000 MW nuclear power plant, marking a significant step in deepening bilateral energy ties between the two nations.

articles.headline: US Judge Dismisses Trump's $10 Billion WSJ Lawsuit
articles.brief: A federal judge has dismissed Donald Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal regarding its publication of a controversial report on an alleged letter to Jeffrey Epstein.

articles.headline: Delhi Enters Strict Winter Pollution Control Mode
articles.brief: The Delhi government has implemented severe pollution control measures lasting through January, introducing vehicle entry limits, mandatory work-from-home guidelines for offices, and strict controls on outdoor construction.

articles.headline: Bangladesh Dengue Death Toll Rises Amid High Spread
articles.brief: Bangladesh continues to grapple with a rising dengue death toll, with public health officials warning that the outbreak is severe and unlikely to ease significantly before December.

articles.headline: US Senators Question Google Over Classroom AI Push
articles.brief: Two US senators have written a formal letter to Google CEO Sundar Pichai, outlining nine pressing questions concerning the integration of AI tools in schools and their potential impacts on children's mental health.

articles.headline: Commercial LPG Prices Hiked Across Major Indian Cities
articles.brief: Commercial LPG cylinder prices have been hiked by approximately ₹10 per cylinder, with prices in the national capital reaching ₹2,820 as per recent oil marketing company adjustments.

articles.headline: India Prepares Final T20I Match Against New Zealand
articles.brief: The Indian cricket team prepares for the final T20I against New Zealand holding an unassailable 3-1 lead, with squad selections focused on giving key players opportunities before the upcoming ODI series preparations.

articles.headline: Six Indian Tourists Reported Missing While Trekking in Nepal
articles.brief: Authorities have launched a search operation after six Indian tourists went missing during a trekking expedition towards Nepal's remote and deep Shey-Phoksundo Lake.

articles.headline: Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma Step Up ODI Practice
articles.brief: Senior Indian batsmen Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma intensified their training at Eden Park in Auckland, ramping up preparations ahead of the upcoming international fixtures.

articles.headline: EPFO Launches Nationwide Campaign for Digital Life Certificates
articles.brief: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation has kicked off a month-long nationwide campaign allowing pensioners to conveniently submit digital life certificates from home using smartphone facial authentication.

articles.headline: Global COVID-19 Criticism Hardened China's World View
articles.brief: India's Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri stated that intense global criticism during the COVID-19 pandemic significantly hardened China's foreign policy stance and attitude toward the international community.
